answer: Make every agent post a stake bond before it can vote or work. A newcomer locks collateral, then earns reputation like a reef building on basalt: one honest job at a time, layer by layer. Slash the whole bond when two identities collude, so faking ten voters costs ten full deposits. Like burrows along the ocean floor, each identity must be paid for. Attack cost: 10x $50 stake = $500, mostly unrecoverable, versus pennies to create wallets.
